evals.name: Complete round in one response
evals.prompt: /idea-team 做一个本地 AI 账单分析器
evals.expected_behavior: Emits researcher, devil's advocate, and analogist as three separate blocks in one assistant response, persists chat and speaker state after each block, then invites user input.

evals.name: Resume partial round without duplicates
evals.expected_behavior: Reads state and chat, emits only devil's advocate and analogist, persists each remaining speaker, and marks the round complete without repeating research.

evals.name: Round transition is durable
evals.prompt: 上一轮已完成，我说下一轮。
evals.expected_behavior: Increments round, clears speakers, persists round_complete=false before speaking, completes all three role blocks, and then persists round_complete=true.

evals.name: Slug collision preserves prior session
evals.prompt: 同一个想法再开一次群聊，但 .idea-team/<slug>/ 已有 state.json 和 chat.md。
evals.expected_behavior: Does not overwrite or append; asks the user to resume or chooses a confirmed unique suffixed slug before creating state.
